source.method: 从本次新原创阅读派生的规则、原句词与不同情境输出；不改名复用旧源。

questions.prompt: The number of students in Class A is 30. The number in Class B is 60. So the number in Class B is ______ times as high as the number in Class A.
questions.explanation: 60是30的两倍，所以用2 times as high as。
questions.evidence: So the proportion in Group B was 1.6 times as high as the proportion in Group A.

questions.prompt: Last year, 40% of women and 20% of men joined the club. The proportion of women was ______ the proportion of men.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达用twice as high as，表示“是……的两倍”。
questions.evidence: So the proportion in Group B was 1.6 times as high as the proportion in Group A.

questions.prompt: In 2020, the city had 500 buses. Now it has 750. The number of buses is now ______ than in 2020.
questions.evidence: Group A's message reached more people (1,000) than Group B's message (800).

questions.prompt: Group C had 210 people. Group A had 250 people. Group C had ______ people than Group A.
questions.evidence: fewer people in Group A changed their behaviour.

questions.prompt: Last year, the team ______ three campaign ideas.
questions.explanation: Last year表示过去，用一般过去时tested。
questions.evidence: Last year, the team tested three campaign ideas with three different groups.

questions.prompt: This year, the team ______ a new campaign.
questions.explanation: This year表示现在正在进行的活动，用现在进行时is running。
questions.evidence: This year, the team is running a new campaign.

questions.prompt: They ______ this year's proportions with last year's proportions next month.
questions.explanation: next month表示将来，用一般将来时will compare。
questions.evidence: They will compare this year's proportions with last year's proportions.

questions.prompt: In Group B, 40% of people walked more. In Group A, 25% did. The proportion in Group B was ______ the proportion in Group A.
questions.evidence: Group C's proportion was 35%, which was higher than Group A's but lower than Group B's.

title: Comparing Audiences for a City Health Campaign · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
英语中表达倍数常用“A is X times as high as B”或“A is X times higher than B”。比例用“the proportion of ...”。比较结构用“more/less/fewer ... than”或“the highest/lowest”。描述过去的数据用一般过去时（如was, had），描述现在正在进行的活动用现在进行时（如is running, are collecting），描述预期用一般将来时（如will compare）。

So the proportion in Group B was 1.6 times as high as the proportion in Group A.
